candidates.background: Elba Garcia was elected Dallas County Commissioner for District 4 in November 2010, the first Latina to serve on the Commissioners Court. She served on the Dallas City Council for District 1 from 2001 and was chosen as Deputy Mayor Pro Tem and Mayor Pro Tem. She is a dentist who has run her own practice since 1998 and was an assistant professor at the Baylor College of Dentistry; she earned dental doctorates in Mexico City (1984) and at Baylor College of Dentistry (1990).

record.text: Her official biography says that in her first term she worked on fixing the county bail bond system and on completing the Hunter-Ferrell Road project in Irving and Grand Prairie.
Her official biography says that in her second term she worked on updating county purchasing rules and ethics policies and expanding small business enterprise certification.

notes.text: She was unopposed in the March 2026 Democratic primary.

issue_notes.summary: Branch reports her campaign supports maintaining property tax rates with no increases and raising the homestead exemption.
